physical.notes: The GI channel drives the factory's playfield GI strings; the retained table models 17 playfield bulbs (its GI collection) and omits the backbox strings the manual lists. The Bigus table's GI collection has 16; GI stays observed without quantity per the GI rule.

Flash bank 5R (Death Star): placed on the single flash bulb the Bigus 3.0 table binds to channel 129 (`FadeL 70, l29`, its script.vbs 531); the retained VPW table comments its bulb assignment out (script.vbs line 1148) and the manual names this bank.

Flash bank 7R (R2D2): placed on the single flash bulb the Bigus 3.0 table binds to channel 131 (`NFadeL 72, l58`, its script.vbs 535). The Bigus object sits on the left rail while the manual names the bank 7R: single-sourced and the side is flagged for physical verification; the retained VPW table comments its bulb assignment out (script.vbs line 1155).
